metrics.name: overall
metrics.description: Overall case-level pass/fail metric. 1.0 for fully passing case, 0.0 for failing. Threshold 0.80 => cases with aggregate score >= 0.80 are treated as pass.

metrics.name: final_response_match
metrics.description: Normalized overlap / LLM-as-judge score comparing agent final response against expected.

metrics.name: tool_trajectory_match
metrics.description: Tool trajectory match: ordered list of tool calls + argument types vs expected.

metrics.name: format_validity
metrics.description: Output format validity: JSON parses, required sections present, no truncation.
